mapper.sql: SELECT plan_id, plan_name, year, is_default, base_lower, base_upper, pension_employer, pension_employee, medical_employer, medical_employee, unemployment_employer, unemployment_employee, injury_employer, maternity_employer, fund_employer, fund_employee, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM biz_hr_ss_plan
mapper.select: WHERE year = #{year} AND is_default = 1 AND (del_flag IS NULL OR del_flag = '0') AND status = '0' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_hr_ss_plan ( plan_name, year, is_default, base_lower, base_upper, pension_employer, pension_employee, medical_employer, medical_employee, unemployment_employer, unemployment_employee, injury_employer, maternity_employer, fund_employer, fund_employee, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{planName}, #{year}, #{isDefault}, #{baseLower}, #{baseUpper}, #{pensionEmployer}, #{pensionEmployee}, #{medicalEmployer}, #{medicalEmployee}, #{unemploymentEmployer}, #{unemploymentEmployee}, #{injuryEmployer}, #{maternityEmployer}, #{fundEmployer}, #{fundEmployee}, #{status}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.delete: UPDATE biz_hr_ss_plan SET del_flag = '2' WHERE plan_id = #{planId}
UPDATE biz_hr_ss_plan SET del_flag = '2' WHERE plan_id IN #{planId}
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_hr_ss_plan SET is_default = 0 WHERE year = #{year} AND plan_id != #{planId} AND (del_flag IS NULL OR del_flag = '0')
